name: Common Crawl index server
tier_rationale: Established non-profit with published terms of use (A8). 'All archives are established non-profits or public bodies: tier trusted, terms open.' (P059 rationale); 'Tiers: Internet Archive, Common Crawl and Brave trusted.' (P287 cond 7).

reliability.justification: Large public web-crawl archive: authoritative for what its crawls captured; coverage is partial and the index server is often overloaded, so a miss is never 'never existed'.

cdx_index.title: Common Crawl CDX index server (collinfo.json and per-crawl indexes)

terms.quote: Registry terms (A1 BR3): the Internet Archive (Wayback CDX and availability), Arquivo.pt (FCT public service), Common Crawl (free terms of use) and CarbonDate (ODU academic service) are 'open', each recorded by legal with evidence

cdx_index.notes: Research C0146 terms 'Common Crawl terms of use (free)'; endpoints https://index.commoncrawl.org/collinfo.json -> {cdx-api}?url=*.{domain}&output=json. The index server is often overloaded (HTTP 504/503, resets): only the newest crawls with backoff, Common Crawl only with --preset deep or -M (P059 cond 3: latest 1-2 indexes). WARC records via Range from data.commoncrawl.org are not seeded here (no batch declared that host): add it with commoncrawl__<batch>.json. Used by web_archives and archive_mining.

notes: Seeded once for batches p1-G01-2 and p2-G01-3 (P059, P060). Overloaded index server (504/503, resets): timeout 30 s, one retry, min_interval 2 s and concurrency 1 to avoid bursts; volume stays low (rule 6). No published limit: no quota block.
